cases.title: Verify both Classic and Modern themes exist under theme preferences
cases.description: Navigate to the theme preferences section and verify that both the Classic and Modern themes are present and listed.

cases.title: Verify theme preferences existence under corrupted configuration state
cases.description: Attempt to access theme preferences when configuration files are missing to ensure system behavior handles missing Classic or Modern themes gracefully.

cases.title: Verify Classic theme display
cases.description: Navigate to theme preferences, select the Classic theme, and verify that it is displayed correctly as shown in the given image.

cases.title: Verify Classic theme display under resolution scaling
cases.description: Verify that the Classic theme display scales correctly and matches the reference image across different display resolutions.

cases.title: Verify Modern Theme Display
cases.description: Verify that the Modern theme is displayed correctly matching the given reference image.

cases.title: Verify Theme Preferences item exists under View menu
cases.description: Open the View menu and verify that the 'Theme Preferences' item is present and available for selection.

cases.title: Verify Get New Themes under View Menu
cases.description: Open the View menu and verify that the 'Get New Themes' item is available.

cases.title: Verify Classic item under View menu
cases.description: Open the View menu and verify that the 'Classic' item is available and correctly listed.

cases.title: Verify Modern item availability under View menu
cases.description: Open the View menu and verify that the 'Modern' item is present and available.

opinions.feedback: The proposed cases are mostly clear and distinct. However, requirements R-176 and R-177 reference 'the given image' which is not provided or accessible in the test requirements specification, making pixel-perfect visual verification against a reference image untestable as specified. All other cases map directly to their requirements and are actionable.
confirmed_blockers: R-176 and R-177 reference a given image that is missing from the requirements, making visual display verification untestable.

analysis.analysis: For R-175: Normal scenario includes navigating to theme preferences and verifying both Classic and Modern themes exist. Edge and abnormal scenarios include missing theme files or corrupted preferences. For R-176: Normal scenario is verifying Classic theme matches the given image. Boundary scenario is checking resolution scaling. For R-177: Normal scenario is verifying Modern theme matches the given image. For R-178: Normal scenario includes checking the View menu for 'Theme Preferences'. For R-179: Normal scenario includes checking the View menu for 'Get New Themes'. For R-180: Normal scenario includes checking the View menu for 'Classic' item. For R-181: Normal scenario includes checking the View menu for 'Modern' item.
